spans.s:
उल्ब उल्ब or उल्व, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वृ), Ved.
the bag which surrounds the embryo; the vulva; the
womb; a cave; [cf. Lat. alvus, vulva; Lith. urwa,
üla; Hib. uile, ‘a corner.’]

उल्बण or उल्वण, अस्, आ, अम्, thick, clotted,
abundant; much, exceeding, superfluous, immense,
strong, powerful; abundantly furnished with; manifest;
(अस्), m., N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha.

उल्ब्य, अस्, आ, अम्, with आपः, the fluid connected
with the embryo; (अम्), n. excess and vitiation of
any of the three humors of the body, bile, phlegm
or wind; any calamity.
